prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objective “best” lawyer for every truck accident case. A useful starting point is **Laird & McCloskey**: its attorneys say they handle Dallas truck cases and hold truck-accident certifications, though their office is in Fort Worth. **Jerry D. Andrews, P.C.** is another Dallas-area option; the firm describes experience litigating truck cases, and Andrews is board-certified in personal injury trial law. These are leads to compare, not endorsements.

When you speak with firms, ask who will personally handle your case, how many similar truck-crash cases they’ve taken to trial, how they preserve evidence such as driver logs and vehicle data, and what fees and case costs you’d owe. Verify credentials and disciplinary history through the State Bar of Texas, and get the fee agreement in writing.

The Dallas Bar Association’s Lawyer Referral Service can connect you with a local attorney: **214-220-7440**. Its listed initial consultation is 30 minutes for $20. Sources: [Laird & McCloskey](https://www.texlawyers.com/dallas-truck-accident-lawyer/), [Jerry D. Andrews, P.C.](https://www.dfwinjurylawyer.com/motor-vehicle-accidents/truck-tractor-trailer-semi), [Dallas Bar Association](https://www.dallasbar.org/?pg=LawyerReferralService).
